newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Bejing Oriental plans 100 mln B share IPO soon.
newsitem.headline: Bejing Oriental plans 100 mln B share IPO soon.

text.p: Beijing Oriental Electronic Co Ltd plans to make an initial public offering (IPO) of 100 million B shares soon after a Hong Kong roadshow in May, a company spokesman said on Monday.
The offer will carry a price/earnings multiple of at least eight times based on forecast net profits for 1997, the spokesman told the Hong Kong-based newsletter China Securities Bulletin.
The company expects about 10 percent growth in its 1997 net profits from about 115 million yuan in 1996 under international accounting standards, the official said.
He declined to give a precise forecast.
Beijing Oriental, which had net profits of about 100 million yuan for 1995 and 90 million yuan for 1994, has appointed China Southern Securities as the domestic lead underwriter, he said.
Based in Beijing, the company makes colour television components and lighting fixtures and will list the foreign currency B shares on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange.
It is among 33 domestic enterprises given the green light by Beijing to list B shares.
The company plans to use the proceeds to expand production, the official said.
Beijing Oriental has a 25 percent stake in the Beijing Matsushita Colour CRT Co Ltd, which notched up net profits of about 500 million yuan in 1996, the official said.
The remaining 75 percent is held by the Matsushita Electronic Industrial Co Ltd and Matsushita Electronics Corp, he said.
Beijing Oriental currently has 260 million outstanding shares composed of institutional and staff shares, the official said. He declined to give futher details.
